android.desc:
Trouble falling asleep? Suffering from insomnia? Feeling stressed or anxious? 

Chillax helps you unwind with a specially curated collection of calming sounds. Designed with you in mind, it’s all about relaxation. No ads, no distractions, just pure serenity.

Here’s how this app can help:
- Fall asleep faster and say goodbye to insomnia and tinnitus.
- Lift your mood, ease anxiety, and reduce stress.
- Stay focused and boost your concentration.

What makes this app stand out:
- 100% ad-free.
- A handpicked selection of high-quality soothing sounds.
- Play sounds in the background while you go about your day.
- Adjust the volume for each sound to suit your preference.
- Set a sleep timer so the sounds stop automatically when you drift off.
- Enjoy all features offline, no internet needed.
- Set optional bedtime reminders to build a healthy sleep routine.
- Beautiful, easy-to-use design.

If you have any questions or feedback, don’t hesitate to reach out at romnanstudio@gmail.com. I’m here to help and always looking to make the app better for you! 😄
